description: Use when the user specifies material requirements (e.g. 'density < 3 g/cm³', 'tensile > 400 MPa', 'max temp ≥ 200°C'). Returns all materials that pass every constraint. Supports gte, lte, eq, contains operators.

property.description: Property name (e.g. density_g_cm3, tensile_strength_mpa, max_service_temp_c, cost_tier)

value.description: Numeric for gte/lte/eq on numeric fields; string for eq/contains on text fields

process_id.description: Optional: only return materials compatible with this process

name: filter_materials_by_constraint
